title: Scaling AI agents across the public service
summary: Singapore is preparing to scale public-sector use of AI agents, with an Institute of Digital Government building AI skills in officers.
pitch: Sovereign-hosted citizen AI agent for federal services, delivered on Garaj with SMS fallback.

title: AI agents piloted in departments; 1823 hotline folded into iAM Smart
summary: The Digital Policy Office plans AI-agent pilots in departments and moves the 1823 enquiry app into the iAM Smart platform.
pitch: One Islamabad citizen helpline and app with an AI agent and SIMOSA-style journeys.

title: AI City innovation technology projects
summary: The land and transport ministry funds six AI City projects with about 30bn won.
pitch: Two AI-city pilots in Islamabad sectors: smart parking and environmental sensing over 5G.

title: From Smart City to AI City
summary: After 60 smart-city initiatives (2016–2025), Selangor plans data- and AI-led policy on centralised GPU infrastructure.
pitch: Provincial urban data platform on Garaj GPU capacity, fed by Quantica IoT.

title: Smart Citizen App linking residents to local authorities
summary: Citizens report issues and reach municipal services through one app under the Smart Cyprus project.
pitch: Islamabad civic app with complaint tracking and JazzCash fee payments.

title: Agent-compatible digital public infrastructure
summary: Argues governments must upgrade DPI so AI agents can use services safely, with audit and permission layers.
pitch: Interoperability and API-gateway layer for the National Digital Masterplan, hosted in-country.

title: AI layered on digital public infrastructure
summary: An NISG–EY report sets out how AI builds on India's identity, payments and data-exchange rails.
pitch: AI-assisted G2P and P2G rails: eligibility checks and fraud analytics on JazzCash flows.

title: Digital twins, urban data platforms and AI agents as one stack
summary: City planning teams are converging digital twins, spatial intelligence and agents, with audit trails required by buyers.
pitch: Islamabad digital twin starting with traffic and water assets, sensors on Quantica Infinity.
